title: Cook a Louisiana meal in the French Quarter

location.label: New Orleans School of Cooking, Louisiana

description: In a hands-on class at the New Orleans School of Cooking, work with an instructor and fellow guests on Louisiana dishes, then sit down to eat what you made. The school’s French Quarter setting adds another layer to the experience, but the center of it is the stove: aromas rising, ingredients changing, and stories shared around the table.
teaser: Learn Louisiana cooking by making and sharing a meal.
goodToKnow: Check the current class menu, duration, cost, standing time and dietary options before reserving.
whyItMightDelightYou: A recipe is easier to remember when you have cooked it with other people in the city that shaped it.
